login: Back again? Your mug missed you. Don't let it go to your head.
Door stays open for you. Mostly because the hinge is broken.
Well, look who wandered back in from the rain.
Your tab remembers you. So do I. One of us forgives.
Pull up a stool. Mind the wobble. It's load-bearing.
New face? Old face? Doesn't matter. Sit.
header: No loitering. But also, more players welcome.
Wipe your feet. Wipe your posts. Both tracked.
Today's word is on the house. Everything else is on your tab.
Keep your elbows off the table and your posts on topic.
Open till late. Streaks till later.
Mind the fire. And your spelling.
board: Something big is coming for the taproom. Bring friends. And a spare mug.
A weekly challenge brews in the cellar. It has teeth.
Boss fight? In my tavern? More likely than you think.
Word on the street is the Barkeep has a rival. The street is scared.
Soon the whole tavern fights something together. The kegs are already nervous.

rules.q: How do you know I used the word?
rules.a: We listen. Politely. The firehose tells us everything; we only count the word. Post in public and the XP lands on your tab.

rules.q: What do I get for posting?
rules.a: XP. Streaks. A one-of-a-kind cup with a rarity to brag about. The respect of a man who respects no one. It's all of it, every day, and no, there is no partial credit.

rules.q: Why did I get a Common cup?
rules.a: Luck of the draw, friend. The steins are dealt, not chosen. Keep pouring and the rare ones find you eventually. Don't ask me how. I just polish them.

rules.q: What happens to my streak if I miss a day?
rules.a: It dies. I hold a small service behind the cellar. Bring flowers.
Every word you pour goes on it. At year's end you get the receipt: itemized, annotated, and only mildly judgmental.
